notes.title: Gamera Game is heading to TGS 2020, special sale is coming!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,
 
Gamera Game will hold [Gamera Game Now! ~ Tokyo Game Show Special ~] at Tokyo Game Show 2020 Online. The press conference will begin on 8pm Sep 24 PDT, save the date!

To celebrate this moment, Gamera Game will join the Steam × Tokyo Game Show special sale event as well. During limited time, Mr.King Luo!Don't be kidding will be a 30% off.

Thank you for your support!

notes.title: New free DLC for Mr.King Luo!Don't be kidding!
notes.notes:
-Model reproduction
After reviewing from the previous quarter, our art team decided to update all the character models in the game and optimize the game content on a large scale. 
-The new chapter of the game 
For the new DLC - Mr.King Luo Don't be kidding pledge to resurrect, we will provide all players to download it for free. The protagonist is finally coming to the gate of resurrect, but the absurd adventure is not over. The new DLC contents new stages. New chapters and new characters will meet you in the new version v2.0.

notes.title: Mr.King Luo!Don't be kidding out now! 20% off for first week
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

Mr.King Luo!Don't be kidding officially released today. Come and grab 20% off release discount!

This is a bullet hell game where players play the protagonist against Kings of Hell. Surprisingly all the Kings of Hell are super cute girls! Could you shoot the girls up to return to the living world?

Let's get start the journey in the hell!

notes.title: 《閻蘿大人！不要鬧》將於2月11日正式上線steam！對著可愛美少女大爆射的遊戲誰不愛呢！
notes.notes:
《閻蘿大人！不要鬧》是一款對著可愛美少女大爆射的遊戲（誤）……應該說是一款對著美少女們射Ｏ的遊戲（認真）。

這是一款玩家扮演一名工程師大鬧陰間的彈幕射擊遊戲！但是這個陰間卻和大家想象中的不一樣，因為這個陰間到處都是可愛的美少女。

既然有這麼多可愛的美少女，那麼福利肯定少不了的，不僅是遊戲內（當然，我們還是有在認真做遊戲），日後我們陸續還會有送幸福的活動，還不趕快追蹤我們的粉絲團，追起來！

そして海外の方々のために、私たちの公式Twitterアカウントがついに開始しました！日本語はまた勉強中ですが、できるだけみんなと
話したいです。

And for customers from abroad, our twitter account is now officially online! We will chat with everyone with our poor language 
ability as possible.
